name: A costed holding lot carries a non-null unit cost and non-negative value; an uncosted lot carries null unit cost and zero placeholder value so totals withhold.

payload.rationale: A costed holding lot carries a non-null unit cost and non-negative value; an uncosted lot carries null unit cost and zero placeholder value so totals withhold.

response.expression: (((self.cost_status == 'costed') and (self.unit_cost != null)) and (self.stock_value >= 0)) or (((self.cost_status == 'missing_cost') and (self.unit_cost == null)) and (self.stock_value == 0))

payload.subject: supply.StockLot
